children: Equity benchmarks rallied more than 2 percent again on November 6, extending their winning streak to seven consecutive sessions, despite weak market breadth. On the NSE, around 2,110 stocks declined, while 1,186 advanced. The market may extend its uptrend during Muhurat Trading; however, consolidation cannot be ruled out thereafter following the sharp rally. Here are some short-term trading ideas for investors and traders to consider:
Vaishnavi Jagtap, Senior Research Analyst – Technical at Axis Direct
GAIL India | CMP: 185.79

With an almost 11 percent rally during the current week, GAIL has decisively broken above the downward-sloping trendline that had capped its gains over the past couple of years, crossing the Rs 178 mark on a closing basis. The breakout was accompanied by strong volumes, indicating a robust comeback by the bulls.

Buying support emerged around the 30-week SMA (Rs 170), which continues to remain a crucial support zone. The stock is comfortably positioned above its 20-day, 50-day, 100-day and 200-day Simple Moving Averages (SMAs). These averages are also gradually trending upwards along with the price, further confirming the bullish trend.
The daily, weekly and monthly Relative Strength Index (RSI) readings are in favourable territory, indicating improving momentum across all time frames.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 196, Rs 204
Stop-Loss: Rs 178
Motilal Oswal Financial Services | CMP: Rs 1,102

Motilal Oswal registered a fresh all-time high of Rs 1,105, indicating bullish sentiment. The stock also closed above the multi-year resistance zone of Rs 1,060. The breakout was accompanied by strong volumes, signalling increased participation.

The stock is comfortably positioned above its 20-day, 50-day, 100-day and 200-day Simple Moving Averages (SMAs). These averages are also gradually trending upwards along with the price, further confirming the bullish trend.
The daily, weekly and monthly RSI readings are in favourable territory, indicating improving strength across all time frames.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 1,212, Rs 1,300
Stop-Loss: Rs 1,060
Adani Green Energy | CMP: Rs 1,424.1

Over the past couple of weeks, Adani Green Energy has taken support at its 200-day SMA and rebounded sharply. During the current week, the stock decisively broke above the multiple resistance zone of Rs 1,340, which had capped its gains for eleven weeks, on a closing basis.

The daily Bollinger Bands indicator has generated a buy signal, indicating improving momentum. The stock is comfortably positioned above its 20-day, 50-day, 100-day and 200-day SMAs. These averages are also gradually trending upwards along with the price, further confirming the bullish trend.
The daily, weekly and monthly RSI readings are in favourable territory, indicating improving strength across all time frames.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 1,545, Rs 1,640
Stop-Loss: Rs 1,365
Osho Krishan, Chief Manager - Technical & Derivative Research at Angel One
Force Motors | CMP: Rs 18,968

Force Motors has staged a strong recovery from its historical support zone of Rs 16,500–17,000, which coincides with a previous consolidation range. The stock has reclaimed all key EMAs, indicating improving bullish momentum and underlying strength.

Its resilient pullback structure further reinforces the positive outlook. Trading near its previous swing highs, the stock appears poised for further upside, supported by a decisive breakout above RSI resistance, signalling strengthening momentum.
Buying is recommended in the stock around Rs 18,600–18,800.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 21,000, Rs 21,200
Stop-Loss: Rs 17,200
ITC | CMP: Rs 283.15
ITC has broken out of its downward-sloping channel over the past week following a sharp corrective phase, indicating the potential emergence of a trend reversal from oversold levels.

The stock has reclaimed its 20-day and 50-day Double Exponential Moving Averages (DEMAs), signalling improving price momentum. Furthermore, the 14-day RSI has rebounded sharply from oversold territory, a development that has historically been associated with meaningful recoveries.
This technical setup offers a favourable risk-reward proposition, subject to sustained momentum and further confirmation. Buying is recommended in the stock around Rs 280.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 300, Rs 315
Stop-Loss: Rs 260
State Bank of India | CMP: Rs 1,018.5

SBI has witnessed a notable rebound from its crucial support zone around Rs 940, with the formation of a potential double-bottom pattern near these pivotal levels, indicating the possibility of a trend reversal.

Furthermore, both the MACD and RSI indicators are signalling positive momentum, supported by bullish crossovers and sustained strength above key reference levels. These technical indicators collectively reinforce the improving bullish outlook and suggest the potential for further upside momentum.
Buying is recommended in the stock around Rs 1,000–1,010.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 1,080, Rs 1,100
Stop-Loss: Rs 940
Jatin Gedia, Technical Research Analyst, VP, Derivatives & Technical Research at Teji Mandi.
Va Tech Wabag | CMP: Rs 1,988.2

VA Tech Wabag formed a Morning Star candlestick pattern, indicating a potential trend reversal, around its 200-day Exponential Moving Average (EMA). In the previous trading session, the stock decisively broke out of a five-day consolidation range of Rs 1,780–1,870, accompanied by strong volumes. This suggests a genuine breakout and indicates a resumption of the primary uptrend.
The daily momentum indicator has also generated a positive crossover, signalling a buy opportunity.

Considering the price-volume breakout, the trend-reversal candlestick pattern near long-term support and the positive momentum setup, the stock appears poised for an upmove over the next few trading sessions towards Rs 2,070. This level coincides with the 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement level of the decline from Rs 2,319 to Rs 1,665.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 2,070
Stop-Loss: Rs 1,910
NTPC | CMP: Rs 323.45

NTPC has formed a higher low around Rs 310, coinciding with the 50 percent Fibonacci retracement level of the rally from Rs 292 to Rs 328, suggesting the possibility of a trend reversal. Last month, the stock formed a Hammer candlestick pattern, while the weekly chart witnessed the formation of a Bullish Engulfing candlestick pattern. Both patterns have bullish implications.
Momentum indicators on both the weekly and daily time frames have generated bullish crossovers, signalling a buy opportunity.

Thus, the formation of bullish candlestick patterns on the monthly and weekly time frames, along with synchronised bullish momentum indicators, points towards positive price action, with potential upside targets of Rs 342, which coincides with the 200-day EMA, and Rs 346, the 100 percent Fibonacci extension level of the rally from Rs 292 to Rs 328.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 342, Rs 346
Stop-Loss: Rs 311
Billionbrains Garage Ventures Groww | CMP: Rs 215.08

Groww broke out on the upside from a six-month consolidation range last week. The stock found support in the Rs 180–185 zone, which coincides with the weekly lower Bollinger Band (Rs 180) and the 200-day EMA (Rs 185). The breakout was accompanied by the highest trading volume since May 2026.
The weekly momentum indicator has triggered a fresh bullish crossover following the formation of a positive divergence, signalling a buy opportunity.
Thus, the price-volume breakout and positive momentum setup suggest that the stock is likely to maintain a positive bias over the next few weeks.
Strategy: Buy
Target: Rs 260
Stop-Loss: Rs 207
